rule.rule: hard gates, then smallest K within one SE of best balanced silhouette
rule.qualitative_rule: candidate must be marked qualitative_preservation=true and undersegmentation=false; then apply numeric hard gates and the one-SE/smallest-K rule

candidates.qualitative_notes: C0 combines near-white background/section edge, pale sparsely cellular tissue, and some eosinophilic or stromal-looking tiles; the remaining two clusters are broad cellular phenotypes. Distinct neutral macro-phenotypes are over-merged.
The additional split refines cellular tissue, but C0 still combines blank/edge content with pale low-cellularity tissue. The same macro-level under-segmentation seen at K=3 remains.

First candidate that cleanly separates a near-blank/background cluster (C1), a pale/low-cellularity mixed tissue phenotype (C0), and three recurring cellular-tissue fine phenotypes (C2-C4). These support three neutral provisional macroregions without anatomical or drug-effect naming.

Retains the K=5 background, pale/low-cellularity, and cellular macro-phenotypes, while adding a further split within the cellular/low-density continuum. The new fine split does not establish an additional clearly distinct macroregion at 48-pixel blinded review.

Retains the K=5 macro-phenotypes and adds a vessel/lumen/edge-rich mixed fine subgroup plus further cellular subdivisions. Low-margin exemplars remain mixed; no additional neutral macroregion is required.

Retains the lower-K macro-phenotypes and isolates a small pale, sparsely cellular/inflammation-like mixed subgroup alongside redundant cellular subdivisions. Anatomical identity is uncertain and requires pathology review.

Retains the background, pale/low-cellularity, and cellular macro-phenotypes but adds another small pale/mixed subgroup and multiple visually overlapping cellular splits; the WSI maps appear more fragmented and slide-specific, without a new required macroregion.

nuisance.limitations: Compressed thumbnails are QC proxies, not raw-slide quantitative stain measurements.
nuisance.scan_time: unavailable as an independent nuisance: one timestamp per WSI, nested in mouse

analyzability.eligibility: all mice have >=20 tiles and >=500 high-confidence neoplastic nuclei

criteria: preserve visually distinct neutral macro-phenotypes across anonymous Slides A-D
separate blank/background or section edge from pale low-cellularity tissue
retain recurring cellular-tissue variation without requiring every fine split to be a new macroregion
inspect centroid-nearest, per-slide-nearest, mid-distance/random, low-margin exemplars and WSI maps
do not use treatment labels, nucleus endpoints, treatment contrasts, or the user ROI to select K
metadata.review_scope: neutral morphology preservation and under-segmentation only
